title: Quarterly Federal Government Finance
description: Quarterly revenue, operating and development expenditure, overall surplus/deficit, and sources of financing for the Federal Government of Malaysia.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 since the data is at quarterly frequency

fields.name: category
fields.title: Category
fields.description: [Categorical] Current budget ('budget') or source of financing ('financing')

fields.name: variable
fields.title: Variable
fields.description: [String] Variable name, to be mapped using the [Lookup Table](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/lookup_federal_finance) where file = 'main'. The lookup table will give you the English and Malay definitions.

methodology:
This data is produced by the Accountant-General's Department in compliance with the [Malaysian Public Sector Accounting Standards](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) and the IMF's Dissemination Standards. A few key relationships should be noted:
- Net development expenditure is gross development expenditure less loan recoveries.
- Net borrowing is gross borrowing less repayments, for both the domestic and foreign sectors.
- The overall balance is revenue less operating expenditure less net development expenditure.
- For stock values (such as use of assets), a positive value indicates the disposal of assets while a negative value indicates the acquisition of assets.
caveat: Numbers may not add up due to rounding during derivation. Furthermore, data for 2023 are preliminary and are subject to revision in future releases.
